# Card 380: preliminary single-reader candidate

[Catalogue](https://crypto.hcportal.eu/dashboard/cryptograms/1699) · [Picture original](https://api.hcportal.eu/media/5157/pc_hcp_380_pic.JPG) · [Address original](https://api.hcportal.eu/media/5158/pc_hcp_380_adr.JPG) · [Full evidence JSON](380.json)

**Partial research candidate; not a solved card.** One key-visible AI source reading was frozen before the first computational decode. Subsequent source review and interpretation used the same context and were nonblind. A second source reading and external confirmation are still needed.

Twelve stepped lower rows clockwise270. Grey speckles/postal/background traces cross some bodies; segmentation and faint small shapes provisional. Ordinary date-like and publisher matter excluded.

The original images/crops remain private. Picture SHA256: `9c8dbb5022c1463429aca0f65c72d70cbe90c3a62b469aa8603bd59ef2263b5d`. Coordinates and full acquisition metadata are in the JSON. Ordinary dates, addresses and postal text are excluded without historical authentication.

## Readable fragments

These are separate editorial proposals tied to exact literal fragments. They are not a continuous translation; omitted stretches remain unresolved. Czech diacritics and question readings are editorial; a proposal does not establish the role of a question-shaped source mark.

proposed_czech:
Srdečný dík, zlato moje, za dnešní drahý lístek. Jsem, Aničko, z celé duše tvůj a těším se též nesmírně na schůzku.

Pracuji již druhý den doma, poněvadž bych v úřadě neměl dosti klidu, abych mohl účty do ustanovené doby dokončiti. Je to letos již asi po čtvrté, že dostali jsme tak zvanou práci.

Tisíc vášnivých pus [svému?] srdéčku posílá věčně jeho Pepouš.

Slečně Jankové vyřiď, prosím, mé poručení.
proposed_english:
Heartfelt thanks, my darling, for today’s dear little letter. Anička, I am yours with all my heart and look forward very much to our meeting as well.

I am working at home for the second day, because I would not have enough peace at the office to finish the accounts by the appointed time. This year it is already about the fourth time that we have been given so-called work.

A thousand passionate kisses to [his?] sweetheart from the forever devoted Pepouš.

Please give Miss Janková my regards.
